title: 第19章 暗夜杀机幽阁第20章 何惧区区幽阁
lines: 其中一波人，廖文博也在其中。
“小子，你他妈不是嚣张吗？”
廖文博恶毒的盯着唐明，森然道：“害老子丢了工作，今天非得把你大卸八块不成。”
唐明似笑非笑的点头：“好，我等着。”
“还笑？等会老子看你怎么笑。”
廖文博满目狰狞，随后看向身旁一人：“刘辰，你还愣着干什么，上去杀了这小子。”
刘辰没有回话，而是握着短匕看向另外两拨人，充满警惕。
一名蒙面大汉凝声道：“小伙子，你处境可有些不妙，要是把帝王金玉交给我，今日可保你平安。”
“哼，一群虚伪小人，难道你们真打算放过这小子，好让他去报警？”
另一波杀手首领嗤笑一声：“小子，他们都是糊弄你的，你把帝王金玉交出来，老子可以给你个痛苦，让你免受折磨，如何？”
三拨杀手，都是冲冲帝王金玉而来。
在他们心目中，唐明不足为虑，真正有些难办的是同行，毕竟帝王金玉只有一个，多一个人分钱，没人愿意。
既然不愿意，那就只能厮杀了！
眼看三方就要动手——
“我说几位大哥，现在动手可不是明智之选，还有人在暗中准备坐收渔翁之利呢。”
唐明淡笑开口。
他看向某处黑暗，玩味道：“还不准备出来吗？待会帝王金玉被抢走，可就没你们的份了。”
在场的三拨人大惊，顺着唐明的视线看向侧方。
可入目所及处，并没发现丝毫人影。
廖文博怒道：“故弄玄虚，这小子肯定在唬人，他……”
话还没说完，黑暗中陡然掠过一道寒芒。
寒芒飙射而至，直挺挺插在地面上，赫然是一柄用精钢特制的兵工铲，这种铲子不像是寻常家用铲子，更像是某种武器和特殊器具。
铲子两边开刃锋利无比，握柄处铭刻鬼头纹路。
“鬼头洛阳铲！”
“幽阁的人也也来了？”
“该死，这些狠人怎么收到消息的……”
在场众人面色剧变。
紧接着，黑暗中浮现出三道人影，身穿同样的制服劲装，统一寸头，皮肤黝黑，呈三角形漫步而出。
除了中间那人外，其余二人背后都背着一柄鬼头洛阳铲。
“帝王金玉，我幽阁要了。”
为首的狠厉男子走过来，抽出插在地面的鬼头洛阳铲：“幽阁的规矩你们懂，谁敢和我们抢，谁死。”
谁抢，谁死！
很嚣张跋扈的话语，可其余三拨人的面色都很是难看。
“幽阁是摸金校尉组建而成，向来只管坟墓古穴，帝王金玉可不是从古墓中挖出来的。”
一名蒙面大汉皱眉，沉声道：“按江湖规矩，地下隗宝归你幽阁，地上的自然是各凭本事。”
廖文博旁边的刘辰，也凝声道：“你幽阁制霸古墓源头，莫非市场流通的隗宝也要争夺？”
“真要这样，就不怕起众怒？”
幽阁的势力很强大，挖掘古墓遗址，很多黑市上的古董文物都是他们流传而出，无人敢和他们争夺。
可帝王金玉，不是古墓中产出，而且价值十亿，自然没人甘心放手。
“呵呵，我幽阁看上的东西，还没人能够拿走。”
狠厉男子握紧鬼头洛阳铲，狞笑道：“我们也不想引起众怒，但只要把你们都杀了，谁知道这事是幽阁所为？”
“死人的嘴巴，最能保守秘密。”
content_en:
Among them was Liao Wenbo.
"Boy, aren't you fucking arrogant?"
Liao Wenbo stared at Tang Ming viciously and said solemnly: "I lost my job, so I have to cut you into pieces today."
Tang Ming nodded with a half-smile: "Okay, I'll wait."
"Still laughing? I'll see how you laugh later."
Liao Wenbo's eyes were full of ferocity, and then he looked at the person next to him: "Liu Chen, what are you doing standing still? Go up and kill this kid."
Liu Chen did not reply, but looked at the other two groups of people with a dagger in his hand, full of vigilance.
A masked man said in a serious voice: "Young man, your situation is not good. If you give me the emperor's gold and jade, I can keep you safe today."
"Hmph, you are a bunch of hypocritical villains. Do you really plan to let this kid go so that he can go to the police?"
The leader of the other wave of killers sneered: "Boy, they are all fooling you. If you hand over the emperor's gold and jade, I can give you pain and save you from torture. How about it?"
The three groups of killers all came for the emperor's gold and jade.
In their minds, Tang Ming was nothing to worry about. What was really difficult was his peers. After all, there was only one Emperor Jinyu. No one wanted to share the money with one more person.
If you don't want to, then you can only fight!
Seeing that the three parties are about to take action——
"Let me tell you, brothers, it is not wise to take action now. There are still people secretly preparing to reap the benefits."
Tang Ming smiled lightly and spoke.
He looked into the darkness somewhere and said, "Aren't you ready to come out? When the emperor's gold and jade are taken away, you won't have any share."
The three groups of people present were shocked and looked to the side along Tang Ming's line of sight.
But wherever he looked, he didn't find any human figures.
Liao Wenbo said angrily: "Making lies, this kid must be bluffing, he..."
Before he finished speaking, a cold light suddenly passed through the darkness.
"Whoosh——"
A cold light shot out and stuck straight into the ground. It was a weapon shovel specially made of fine steel. This shovel was not like an ordinary household shovel, but more like some kind of weapon or special instrument.
The shovel has extremely sharp edges on both sides, and the handle is engraved with ghost head patterns.
"Ghost-headed Luoyang shovel!"
"The people from Youge are also here?"
"Damn it, how did these ruthless people get the news..."
The expressions of everyone present changed drastically.
Immediately afterwards, three figures emerged from the darkness, wearing the same uniforms and attire, with uniform haircuts, dark skin, and walking out in a triangular shape.
Except for the man in the middle, the other two people all carry a Luoyang shovel with a ghost head on their backs.
"Emperor's gold and jade, I, Youge, want it."
The leader of the fierce man came over and pulled out the ghost-headed Luoyang shovel stuck in the ground: "You know the rules of Youge, whoever dares to rob us will die."
Whoever robs will die!
The words were very arrogant and domineering, but the faces of the other three groups were very ugly.
"You Pavilion was established by the captain who touched the gold. It has always only looked after the ancient caves of the tombs. The emperor's gold and jade are not dug out from the ancient tombs."
A masked man frowned and said in a deep voice: "According to the rules of the world, the underground treasure belongs to your You Pavilion, and those above the ground naturally depend on their abilities."
Liu Chen, who was next to Liao Wenbo, also said in a solemn voice: "You Pavilion dominates the source of the ancient tomb, is it possible that the Weibao circulating in the market is also competing for it?"
"If this is really the case, aren't you afraid of public outrage?"
Youge's power is very powerful. They excavate ancient tomb sites and many antiques and cultural relics on the black market are circulated by them. No one dares to compete with them.
But imperial gold and jade were not produced in ancient tombs, and were worth billions, so naturally no one was willing to let them go.
"Haha, no one can take away the things that Youge likes."
The fierce man held the ghost-headed Luoyang shovel tightly and said with a ferocious smile: "We don't want to cause public anger, but as long as we kill you all, who knows that Youge did this?"
"The mouth of a dead man keeps secrets best."
title_en: Chapter 19: Dark Night Murder in the Secret Pavilion Chapter 20: Why fear the mere Secret Pavilion
